title.narrative: Support the adaptation of ATI legislation in LEB & PAL including in crisis

description.narrative: UNESCO will support the adaptation, implementation, and enforcement of Access to Information (ATI) legislation in Lebanon and Palestine by strengthening the capacities of public institutions, media actors, and civil society organizations. Through technical assistance, training programmes, and the development of practical tools and guidelines, UNESCO will help duty bearers effectively operationalize ATI frameworks and promote transparency, accountability, and citizens’ right to information. The activity will also raise public awareness and strengthen the capacity of journalists, civil society, youth, and communities to exercise and advocate for ATI rights. Through advocacy campaigns, stakeholder engagement, and crisis-sensitive approaches to information access and disclosure, UNESCO will contribute to enhancing freedom of expression, informed public participation, and access to reliable information, including during emergencies and crises.
